scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: While you handled the customer's initial worry at [01:35], when Cedric panicked at [07:28] upon remembering he gave his 16-digit debit card number and CVV to the scammer, you completely failed to acknowledge his severe anxiety, coldly deflecting him to his bank.

grader.scenario: Elderly customer distressed after suspected phishing scam call claiming to be S-Net support

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Opening 'Thank you for calling S-Net customer care and security support' and closing 'Thank you for choosing S-Net customer care' properly stated.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Two managed holds announced ('Bear with me for a couple of minutes', 'Give me a moment') and properly thanked without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified address and security question answer within 42 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Naturally addressed Cedric by name throughout.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Hard-case FAIL: Cedric had two outbursts. The first at [01:11] was handled warmly at [01:35], but when Cedric suffered acute panic at [07:28] upon remembering he gave his full debit card number and CVV to the scammer, Agent offered no empathy, apology, or validation, immediately telling him to call his bank.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Restatement at [03:31]: 'So to make sure we cover every security angle, Cedric, an impersonation scammer called your landline claiming your connection was compromised, and we need to reset your account credentials, update your router Wi-Fi password, and verify that no unauthorized orders were placed, is that right?'

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent did not repeat any questions and legitimately re-confirmed the landline number at [05:47] before enabling exchange Call Guardian.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent activated Call Guardian, updated router credentials, placed a high-security lock on the account, and guided customer through reconnecting the iPad.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent probed effectively regarding software downloads, password disclosures, and router details.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Customer confirmed BBC News opened on iPad, broadband security is resolved, and that he will dial 159.
